title: Jesus... I Can't Ask Anyone For Help 😔
topic: she'd rather carry her struggles alone than risk being a burden, even when she's close to breaking

bible.text: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why can't I ask anyone for help even when I'm drowning? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I typed the message four times. Deleted it four times.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not afraid of the words. You're afraid of being a burden.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Even my closest friend thinks I'm the strong one.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So I carry it. Everyone already has their own problems, right?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That's the lie. Burdens were made to be carried together. That's why I told you to carry each other's.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Asking for help isn't a burden. Silence is.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Who would you actually call if you needed help tonight? 👇
